description: Create a detailed static GLB with Mint Modeler from text, owned reference-image IDs, or both. This is the Modeler workflow, separate from start_model_generation and its Preview presets. Choose quality_tier (low, the default, 2,000; medium 8,000; high 25,000; max 100,000; ultra 625,000 Credits), provide the user's max_credits and a stable request_id. The limit must cover the tier price. Reserves that price and charges actual usage up to it. Reuse request_id with identical input after a timeout to avoid duplicate paid work. Poll get_modeler_operation until delivery and billing settlement, then retrieve the GLB through get_asset_artifact_manifest with asset_type model and resource.id. No Preview approval, rigging, animation, or uploaded-model editing. Each owned Modeler session runs one request at a time.

conversation_id.description: Existing owned Modeler session. Omit to create a session.

max_credits.description: User-authorized Credit ceiling. Must cover the tier's price. Only the tier's price is reserved; actual usage up to that price is charged.

quality_tier.description: Low (default) reserves 2,000 Credits, Medium 8,000, High 25,000, Max 100,000, Ultra 625,000. Choose the user's tier before spending.

reference_image_ids.description: referenceAssetId values returned by upload_reference_image (not its imageUrl): up to 8, or up to 50 on any subscription plan. The upload needs a project_id; any owned Project works.

request_id.description: Stable unique ID for this request, such as a UUID. Reuse it with identical inputs after a timeout; use a new ID for new work.

name: start_modeler_generation
